title: Segment Tree
description: Write a Zig program that implements a segment tree for range sum queries.
hints: Segment tree stores range aggregates (sums) in a binary tree structure
Leaf nodes store individual array elements, internal nodes store combined values
Range query traverses the tree, combining results from relevant nodes
Use 4× N array size for safe segment tree storage
